description: For new meals prefer log_meal. Prepare the exact meal edit, saved food, profile, weight or dated goals change the user requested. For meal or library food changes preserve the full 54-nutrient panel and ingredient coverage, not just macros. Show a brief nutrition summary and disclose estimate assumptions before logging; include all supported values in the payload and show the full table only on request. Never replace unavailable nutrients with zero. This tool does not save nutrition data. Use a fresh UUID request_id, reusing only for an identical retry. With routine saves enabled, confirmationRequired:false permits apply_change immediately for the requested ordinary save; do not ask again or open a browser. Otherwise return the reviewUrl for the user to approve. Deletions always require three website confirmations; never automate them. Proposals expire after ten minutes. Clarify ambiguous values/portions; use catalog units, set_macro_targets for main macros and set_nutrient_goals for other nutrients. Never invent medical presets or medication instructions.
